title: What does the next pick add?
hook: A set can lose marginal value as coverage grows.

knows: A score to maximise over many candidates; distance between points.
doesNotKnow: a candidate's value is its newly covered items given the current set, not its fixed standalone size. Explicit bridge from a single-variable economic curve to a set function: the inputs are subsets and a candidate's marginal depends on which elements are already selected.

claims.text: The retained B covers four items alone, adds two after A, and adds only one after A plus D. Its marginal gain depends on what is already covered. Coverage has diminishing set gains. The complements countercase instead gains more after another choice, so it is not submodular.
